The text 'Diag' in the top-left corner is rendered on top of the background art without any container, making it appear as a debug overlay that should not be visible to players.
The text 'Region 1' and 'Cards: 0' under 'Warrior' have very low contrast against their dark background, making them difficult to read.
The text 'SEX' is present as a UI label, which is likely a placeholder or an error, as 'SFX' (Sound Effects) is the common term in game settings.

The overall layout is severely unbalanced, with a large empty space on the right side of the screen while all interactive elements are crammed into the left, making it look unfinished.
